key.name: workspaces-per-monitor
key.description: How many workspaces every monitor has.

key.name: wrap-around
key.description: Scrolling past the last workspace goes to the first one (and back).

key.name: show-osd
key.description: Show "2 / 4" on the monitor that switched.

key.name: take-over-panel-scroll
key.summary: Scroll on Dash to Panel switches that monitor only
key.description: When Dash to Panel's panel scroll action is "Switch workspace", Nero turns it off in Dash to Panel and does it per monitor instead (put back when Nero Workspaces is switched off).

key.name: scroll-threshold
key.description: How much smooth scroll one workspace step needs (1.0 = one wheel notch).

key.name: scroll-cooldown-ms
key.description: After a step, scroll is ignored this long, so a fast wheel or a touchpad flick moves one workspace, not all of them.

key.name: saved-gnome-settings
key.description: dynamic-workspaces, workspaces-only-on-primary and num-workspaces from before Nero Workspaces was switched on; put back when it is switched off.

key.name: saved-dtp-scroll
key.summary: Dash to Panel's panel scroll action (internal)
key.description: Put back when Nero Workspaces is switched off.
